title: Protective Ability of Biogenic Antimicrobial Peptide Microcin J25 Against Enterotoxigenic Escherichia Coli-Induced Intestinal Epithelial Dysfunction and Inflammatory Responses IPEC-J2 Cells.
summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered primary MIC, cytotoxicity, adhesion, and host-response rows; reconciled all linked DBAASP rows; replaced placeholder mechanism notes; and closed the only targeted rework ticket with explicit cautions.
adjudication_summary: Publication-grade for obtainable local material with cautions: MccJ25 is source-supported at MIC 0.25 ug/mL against ETEC K88 and as non-cytotoxic to IPEC-J2 cells up to 256 ug/mL, while exact graph-derived bar/CFU values are not tabulated and no extra activity table exists in the supplement.

materials_exhausted.note: Presentation_1.PDF and Table_1.DOCX were reopened; Table_1.DOCX is primer-only, Presentation_1.PDF is production/purification only, and landed .bin supplementary files are HTML landing pages. No further activity/toxicity table is locally recoverable.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplement extraction is inventory-based, but the local XML/PDF/OA package/DOCX/PDF/database surfaces relevant to worker-2/4/6 were exhausted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required packet/final JSON files exist with source locators, status vocabulary, provenance, and rework closure fields.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All five linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows are source-verified against primary text or article metadata; the missing linked_sequence_records snapshot is preserved as a caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Seven source-supported rows cover MIC, qualitative inhibition/time-kill, cytotoxicity, adhesion, and ETEC-challenge LDH/TEER protection; no graph-only exact values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to direct activity assays and host-response/pathway readouts; no unsupported molecular target is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The only open rework request has been answered with checked source paths and no remaining blocking/major issue.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figure panels support qualitative/statistical findings, but exact bar heights and time-kill CFU values are not tabulated in XML/PDF/DOCX.
Presentation_1.PDF describes production/purification and Table_1.DOCX contains primer sequences, so neither adds activity/toxicity rows.
DBAASP linked sequence records are absent from the packet; primary paper sequence evidence was used for record context.
The paper measures activity and host-response markers but does not prove the molecular target of MccJ25 in ETEC K88.
